clauses.title: Scope – Requirements regarding material, grade,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements regarding material, grade, types, sizes, construction, finishes and tests of wooden flush door shutters of solid core type with particle board face panels (both veneered and unveneered) and hardboard face panels.

clauses.title: Block
clauses.text: 2.1   Block Decorative with skins of    BDPV board decorative veneered particle board. Non-decorative with skins   BNP of particle boards unveneered. Non-decorative with skins   BNPV of particle boards veneered with commercial veneers.

clauses.title: Particle
clauses.text: 2.2 Particle Decorative with skins of PDPV* Boardwith decorative veneered particle or without board. Blockboard Non-decorative with skins   PNP* of particle boards unveneered. Non-decorative with skins     PNPV* of particle boards veneered with commercial veneers. *  Where particle board beaded core is used, the designations will be PEDPV,  PENP and PENPV respectively.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 3.2 Tolerances — Tolerances on nominal width and height shall be  and the tolerance on nominal thickness shall be . mm. The thickness of the door shutter  shall be uniform throughout with a permissible variation of not more than 0.8 mm when measured at any two points.

clauses.title: Timber – As per
clauses.text: 4.1 Timber - As per IS 2202 (Part 1) : 1999. Note— For details of materials see 4 of the standard.

clauses.title: Face Panels – Thickness
clauses.text: 5.1 Face Panels - Thickness of the face panels of particle board shall be not less than 4 mm and of hardboard not less than 3 mm.

clauses.title: Locks – Shutters shall
clauses.text: 5.2 Locks -  Shutters shall be shop-prepared for taking mortice locks or latches.

clauses.title: Workmanship and Finish –
clauses.text: 6. Workmanship and Finish - All the four edges of the door shutter shall be square. The shutter shall be free from twist or warp in its plane.

clauses.title: Both faces of door
clauses.text: 6.1 Both faces of door shutter shall be sanded to a smooth even texture.

clauses.title: Tests – Shall satisfy
clauses.text: 7. Tests - Shall satisfy the tests prescribed in the standard.
